**Issue #2691 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2691: Patch: the AI reads its own deck as its owner was shown it, so a card turned Radiant inside the deck stays unknown to it
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
Eugenics gives each card left in your deck a 30% chance to become Radiant, and Knockoff Temu Glowy Jelly Bean can turn cards in your deck Radiant at random. A person who plays them is not told which cards changed until they draw them: the deck list keeps showing the cards as they went in. The practice AI, though, keeps the true cards in its own deck when it imagines the game ahead, so it knows exactly how many of its coming draws are Radiant and plans with that. Once built, the AI sees its own deck as a person in its seat would, the cards as they went in.

## Why
- R311: “A change made inside a library, where nobody reads it, does not show: a card #28 picks or #42 rolls Radiant there is listed with the face it went in with until it leaves”; R386: “its owner does not see a change made inside a deck until the card leaves it”. CLAUDE.md, Architecture: in `crates/ai`, hidden cards never change a decision.
- `crates/ai/src/observe.rs:222-236` hides one of the seat's own library cards only when the opponent's deck minted it or it has no `known_as` (R312). Step 3 (`:572-602`) turns only hidden cards into placeholders, so every other library card keeps its true `radiant`, `cost_mod` and the rest, and `crates/ai/src/determinize.rs:448-454` only shuffles the library. The evaluation then prices a drawn card by its Radiant face (`radiant_in_hand`, `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs:459-473`).
- The siblings keep the rule: the owner's library list reads only `known_as` (`crates/engine/src/own_library.rs:88-126`); the dry run hides the viewer's own library whole (`crates/engine/src/subsystems/scorer.rs:703-706`); and `redact` already forgets hidden Nerfs “so no seat's decision hangs on it” (R1845000, `observe.rs:611-613`).

## Proposal
- In `redact`'s step 3, rebuild each of the seat's own library cards that has `known_as` and was not hidden as its owner was shown it: reset it as `to_placeholder` would, then set `def_id` and `radiant` from `known_as` (keeping the id, `known_as` itself and anything R311 says is shown, such as a Created mark).
- A ruling in this issue's block extending R312 to the seat's known cards, with `spec/pending/<issue>.md`; rejected alternative to record: hiding the whole own library as the dry run does, which would also throw away what the owner was legitimately shown.
- Re-run `cargo jackioh gate`, since it changes what the AI plans with.

## Where it lands
- `crates/ai/src/observe.rs`; tests in `crates/ai/tests/ai/observe.rs` beside the r312 test
- `spec/rulings/R<n>.md`, `spec/pending/<issue>.md`; SPEC §9.9, §10.8; R311, R312

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Two states that differ only in whether a card in the AI's own library turned Radiant after it went in redact to the same state for that seat (same hash), as the r312 test does for unshown cards.
- [ ] A card shown Radiant as it went in (a Radiant copy shuffled in openly) still reads Radiant.
- [ ] The AI's choice on a fixed seed after Eugenics resolves is the same whatever the roll's outcome.
- [ ] Tests named after the new ruling, listed in its `proven_in`; `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`, clippy, `cargo jackioh gate` and `cargo jackioh spec check` pass.

## Size and risks
Small (hard by label, the AI): about 15 lines and two tests. Risk: low; the AI plans with slightly less, exactly what R311 says its seat knows. Check that the lethal hint (`crates/ai/src/lethal.rs:508`), which builds on the same redacted copy, still passes its tests.

Make the practice AI’s redacted copy of its own library retain the placeholder’s structural instance fields but otherwise contain only what that seat’s owner-visible library list records: the definition and face in `known_as`, the record itself, and the visible Created mark, with live in-library Radiant rolls and other instance changes erased. | --- | --- | --- |

| `crates/ai/tests/ai/observe.rs` | change | Add R2691000 redaction and fixed-seed decision regressions beside the R312 own-library test. |
| `crates/ai/README.md` | change | Amend the `decide`/`redact` contract to say the AI reads known own-library cards from their owner-visible snapshots, not their live hidden instance data. |

| `spec/pending/2691.md` | new | Add R2691000’s pending §11 paragraph, including the rejected whole-library-hiding alternative. |

## Steps

1. Add `spec/rulings/R2691000.md` with `id: R2691000`, title “The AI reads its own library as its owner was shown it,” `cards: "§9.9, §10.8, #28, #42, R185, R311, R312, R386, R943"`, and the sole `proven_in` entry `crates/ai/tests/ai/observe.rs`. Rule that a known card in the AI seat’s own library keeps the structural id/ownership/location fields a placeholder needs, then is rebuilt from `knownAs.defId` and `knownAs.radiant` with the `knownAs` record and owner-visible `created` mark retained; live `radiant`, cost/tuning, buffs, counters, memory, keywords/tags, and other hidden instance data are forgotten. R312 placeholders still cover cards without `knownAs`, and R185 still hides order. Record the rejected alternative: concealing the entire own library as `scorer::conceal_from` does would discard identities/faces the owner was legitimately shown.
2. Add `spec/pending/2691.md` with the dated R2691000 §11 paragraph. Summarize the owner-snapshot rule, the Eugenics/#28 fairness consequence, the whole-library alternative and why it was rejected, and say it edits §9.9 and §10.8 and extends R311/R312 for AI redaction.
3. In `spec/09-architecture.md` §9.9’s **Information** bullet, expand the own-library determinization sentence: order remains shuffled, but before simulation each known card is reduced to the definition/face its `knownAs` recorded and owner-visible library marks, so an in-library Radiant roll or other hidden mutation cannot affect a decision; link R2691000. In `spec/10-engine-guide.md` §10.8’s opening own-library paragraph, add that `redact` uses those same entries for the AI rather than the live card data and link R2691000.
4. In `crates/ai/src/observe.rs`, update the module/step-3 comments to cite R2691000 and distinguish R312’s wholly hidden cards from owner-known cards whose live fields are concealed. Immediately after the existing `every_place` loop that calls `to_placeholder` for `hidden` ids, iterate `next.players[seat].library`: skip ids in `hidden`; clone its non-`None` `known_as` and save `created`; call `to_placeholder(card)`; restore `def_id` and `radiant` from the cloned `KnownAs`, restore `known_as = Some(known_as)`, and restore `created`. Do not add a sampler or mutate the input; let the existing step 4 sort and `determinize` shuffle this sanitized library.
5. In `crates/ai/README.md`, amend the “`decide` reads only `redact`” list so it explicitly says the AI’s own library keeps the order hidden, completely hides R312 cards, and reconstructs every known card from the owner-visible `known_as` snapshot under R2691000.
6. In `crates/ai/tests/ai/observe.rs`, beside `r312_a_card_in_the_seats_own_library_it_was_never_shown_is_hidden_so_what_it_is_cannot_move_a_decision`, add `r2691000_a_known_own_library_card_redacts_to_the_face_the_owner_was_shown`. Build one `real_game("observe-r2691000-library")`; on its first AI-library card keep `known_as.radiant == false` but set the same hidden `cost_mod` in both states, then clone and change only that card’s live `radiant` to true in the twin. On a second card in both states, set the live face and `known_as.radiant` to true and `created` to `Some(true)`, modeling an openly shuffled Radiant Created copy. Assert the true hashes differ, the two `redact(..., AI)` hashes match, the secretly changed card is base with zero `cost_mod` and its base `known_as` in both redactions, and the openly recorded card remains Radiant and Created with its Radiant `known_as` intact; look both cards up by saved instance id because step 4 sorts the library.
7. In the same test module, add `r2691000_eugenics_hidden_radiant_rolls_do_not_change_the_ais_fixed_seed_decision`. Register the real scripts; construct a `scenario` whose p1 hand is base `core-042` Eugenics plus `core-005` Stockpile and whose library is twenty base `core-025` cards (all cost 4, so Eugenics exiles none), then play Eugenics so Stockpile keeps p1’s main phase open. Clone that resolved state into two possible roll-result vectors without changing `known_as`: set every remaining live library `radiant` flag false in one and true in the other. Assert the true hashes differ and `decide` returns the same full `Decision` for both with `ai_options("observe-r2691000-eugenics-choice", AI_BUDGET)`. Keep this test on the real Eugenics resolution path; do not mock evaluation or determinization.

## Tests

- `crates/ai/tests/ai/observe.rs` — `r2691000_a_known_own_library_card_redacts_to_the_face_the_owner_was_shown`: hidden live Radiant state hashes alike after redaction, while an openly recorded Radiant Created card stays so.
- `crates/ai/tests/ai/observe.rs` — `r2691000_eugenics_hidden_radiant_rolls_do_not_change_the_ais_fixed_seed_decision`: the same AI RNG produces the same decision for opposite unseen Eugenics roll outcomes.
- Run `cargo test -p jackioh-ai r2691000`.
- Run `cargo test -p jackioh-ai` after the focused regressions pass, as the issue’s crate-level acceptance check.
- Run `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`.
- Run `cargo fmt --check`.
- Run `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `cargo jackioh patches check`, and `cargo jackioh spec check`.
- Do not run `cargo jackioh gate` in this shared bot job: the run instructions expressly reserve whole AI gates for the daily suite; the targeted invariance tests protect this change until that gate runs.

## Done when

- [ ] Known own-library cards redact from `known_as`, not live hidden fields; R312 cards remain placeholders and library order remains concealed.
- [ ] A hidden post-entry Radiant change produces the same redacted hash and fixed-seed AI decision, while an openly recorded Radiant Created card remains Radiant and Created.
- [ ] R2691000 exists in the issue’s block, both tests name it, `proven_in` names their file, and §9.9, §10.8, the AI README, and `spec/pending/2691.md` agree with it.
- [ ] Targeted R2691000 tests, crate-local clippy, rustfmt, catalog, patches, and spec checks pass; no generated wire diff appears.
- [ ] The builder does not invoke `cargo jackioh gate` in this shared job; its execution is left to the repository’s daily AI-gate job as the run instructions require.

## Risks

- Restoring the live `CardInstance` after `to_placeholder` would preserve the leak; save and restore only `KnownAs`, its two fields, and `created`, which `own_library_view` proves is the complete visible entry data.
- Hiding every own-library card would alter legal player knowledge and determinization; skip R312-hidden ids in the new reconstruction loop and retain their existing placeholder/sample path.
- Sampling or changing shuffle order would perturb deterministic choices and replays; this change performs no RNG operation and leaves `determinize`’s existing own-library shuffle untouched.
- `redact` can receive an already redacted state; restoring `known_as` makes the new pass idempotent, as the existing placeholder handling requires. The fixed-seed decision test and existing lethal-hint tests cover consumers of the same redacted copy.

## Open questions

None. R2691000 is the first free number in issue #2691’s block, and the spec plus `own_library_view` settle the visible fields and the rejected whole-library design.
```
